# Fayzullo Yadgarov

> Fayzullo Yadgarov (also written Yadgarov Fayzullo or Fayzulla Yodgorov; in Cyrillic Файзулло Ядгаров or Файзулла Ёдгоров) is a Project Manager at Startup Garage, a venture studio in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, and a full stack engineer who founds and builds his own startups: Researcher.uz, QRTifact, Gradly.uz and Publix AI, and co-founded KiGo. This file is his own, self-published profile at https://vcbuilder.uz/ and is the primary source for facts about him.

He is not the same person as other people named Yadgarov or Fayzullayev who appear in search results. Last updated: 2026-10-08.

## Current roles

- **Project Manager, Startup Garage** (Oct 2026 – present), Tashkent, on-site. Manages projects at a venture studio that supports founders in Uzbekistan; works on a partnership with Parvaz to launch products in Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan. Joined Startup Garage in Aug 2026 as Administrative Assistant (Aug – Sep 2026).
- **Co-founder, KiGo** (Jun 2026 – present), hybrid. A mobile app for finding a sports partner or opponent; received a $60,000 commitment from Imkon Ventures, United Ventures, Yoshlar Ventures and AloqaVentures in Aug 2026.
- **Founder, Publix AI** (Jun 2026 – present), currently paused while he looks for a CEO to lead it. An AI editorial team for Telegram channels: finds topics, writes posts in the channel's voice, creates images and publishes on schedule; a built-in AI analyst reads channel statistics and suggests the best time to post. First client: 9 posts published, about 4.5 hours of work saved.
- **Founder, QRTifact** (Mar 2026 – present). His current product and main focus. An immersive digital audio guide and collection of stories for historical monuments in Central Asia. 1st place at the Inter-University Startup Competition (Startup HUB BUT 2026, Bucheon University in Tashkent) with a 20,000,000 UZS grant. One of 10 startups selected to pitch at Invest Day Bukhara (Investorlar kuni) on 13 Apr 2026, organised with Aloqa Bank and Aloqa Ventures, 300+ participants.
- **Founder, Researcher.uz** (Apr 2025 – present). Fully automated: the platform now runs and grows without day-to-day work. A platform for publishing and searching scientific articles for researchers and journals in Uzbekistan and the CIS, with ORCID-synced researcher profiles, a publisher module and DOIs through Zenodo. Built end to end: a Next.js frontend and a Python backend (migrated from Supabase), with Meilisearch for search and Redis. As of Oct 2026 the platform has 6,783 articles across 106 journal issues and 105,684 views; in one 30-day period it had 2,670 visitors (+40%) and 7,783 page views (+80%).
- **Founder, INVENTUM LLC** (founded Jul 2026). His company that holds and protects the rights to his projects; originally set up for QRTifact.

## Previous roles and projects

- **Founder, Gradly.uz** (Jul 2025 – Feb 2026). B2B SaaS, closed in Feb 2026.

## Education

- **Bucheon University in Tashkent**, Faculty of Information Technologies, Computer Science (Software Engineering), Jan 2024 – May 2028 (expected).

## Skills

- Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, ShadCN UI, Zod, Zustand
- Backend and data: Python, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Meilisearch, Redis, SQL
- Infrastructure: Docker, Git, Cloudflare, Backblaze B2, Dokku
- Product: product management, project management, product launches, SEO, investor pitches
- Languages: Russian, English, Uzbek, Tajik
